\par\smallskip\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\textit{Notes:} Scores of the 5 platforms of La Libertad Avanza by election, filed with the C\'amara Nacional Electoral and scored out of sample with the identical pipeline and aggregation rule as the baseline (CF = Capital Federal, BA = Buenos Aires province; 2023 = national platform, filed for the primaries (PASO) and the general election). Panels: populism, ideology ($-$1 to +1) and the five liberalism scores (0--10). Horizontal lines: baseline means of all parties in the world, Latin America and Argentina, and of right-wing populist parties in the world (right-wing = ideology $> 0$; right-wing populist = ideology $> 0$ and populism above the baseline median (3.97)).\end{minipage}
